summary: Iteration 5: Tested AR360 catalog refresh - 39 consolidated products, variants, image proxy, visibility filters, categories, frontend shop & product detail pages. 16/16 backend pytest tests pass. Shop page and product detail variant selectors work correctly. Found 2 frontend issues: 4 products use a broken Unsplash fallback URL, and the /admin-login frontend form does not appear to call /api/login on submit (redirects straight to /auth).

ui_bugs.issue: Broken Unsplash fallback URL https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583912267550-d6c2ac3196c0 (Unsplash returns 404). Used by 4 products: 'Marc Pro Original', 'Marc Pro Reusable Electrodes', 'Squid Go Control Unit', 'Squid Go Body Part Systems'. Renders as a broken/blank image.

integration_issues.issue: Submitting the Staff Login form with admin@example.com / password (also tried 'admin' / 'password') redirects to /auth instead of an admin area. No /api/login network call was captured during form submit, suggesting the form handler is not calling the backend admin endpoint (or is silently redirecting on Firebase fallback). Backend POST /api/login works correctly (returns JWT with isAdmin=true) per pytest. Result: /admin/products is unreachable via the UI.

issues: Console warning: 'Failed to decode downloaded font: fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Open+Sans...' / 'OTS parsing error: invalid sfntVersion' - Google Fonts CSS appears to be served with a font MIME type. Cosmetic only; default fonts render fine.

passed_tests: No MongoDB _id leaks in product responses
GET /api/categories returns 11 categories including 'Cold Compression', 'Exercise Therapy', 'Kinesiology Tape'
Incrediwear Knee Sleeve has exactly 25 variants
Hampton Adams Kinesiology Tape — 2 Pack has 10 color variants
Hampton Adams Kinesiology Tape — Clinic Roll has 10 color variants
Hot/Cold Compression Sleeve has 4 size variants (S/M/L/XL)
GET /api/products?visibility=doctor returns Marc Pro/Squid Go/Bio Blade etc.
All 9 /api/files/ar360/products/* image URLs return 200 with image/* content-type
Frontend /shop renders 39 product cards with images, prices, descriptions
Frontend /product/{id} for Hot/Cold Compression Sleeve renders Size dropdown (4 options), changing to L updates 'Selected: Size L (10 in stock)'
Frontend /product/{id} for Hampton Adams 2-Pack renders Color dropdown showing Black with '10 in stock'
action_items: Replace the broken Unsplash fallback URL (photo-1583912267550-d6c2ac3196c0) used by Marc Pro and Squid Go products. Either upload official images to object storage or pick a working Unsplash photo. Affected products: Marc Pro Original, Marc Pro Reusable Electrodes, Squid Go Control Unit, Squid Go Body Part Systems.

Investigate /admin-login form submit: it should call POST /api/login and store JWT, then route to admin dashboard. Currently it silently redirects to /auth without an /api/login call, blocking access to /admin/products via UI.

Optional: only 9 of 39 products have official /api/files images; task statement mentioned 27 images uploaded. Confirm whether more products should be mapped to uploaded images instead of Unsplash fallbacks.
critical_code_review_comments: Image fallback strategy hardcodes Unsplash URLs that can become 404 (e.g., 1583912267550-d6c2ac3196c0). Consider a single bundled placeholder asset served from /api/files for resilience.
Login response shape changed to {token, user:{...}} (with user.isAdmin) - older test_ar360_api.py expected flat user object; updated test in test_ar360_catalog.py handles new shape.
Frontend admin-login flow: ensure the Sign In button's onSubmit handler awaits POST /api/login, persists token, then navigates to /admin (not /auth).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (shop + product detail + variant selectors work; admin-login & broken fallback image fail)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Catalog refresh verified at API level: 39 products, variants intact, image proxy works for all 9 local images. Open issues: (1) 4 products use a 404 Unsplash URL (1583912267550-d6c2ac3196c0); (2) /admin-login form does not POST /api/login - redirects to /auth without API call. Backend admin login API itself is fine. Tests in /app/backend/tests/test_ar360_catalog.py.
rca_of_the_issue: Broken images: products without an uploaded official asset fall back to a hardcoded Unsplash photo ID that is no longer hosted on Unsplash, returning 404 and rendering blank in the browser. Admin login: form submit handler is not invoking POST /api/login (no network call observed); likely the page is wired to Firebase or rerouting before the staff endpoint executes.
